prompt.note: One short fact line states the current step count and earlier action labels only, plus an optional local event delta derived solely from already-saved views. Earlier result text stays in the private journal and is not repeated in the prompt. Structured JSON output is a harness bound. It is not a shell.

purpose: Compare a guide-only local arrival prompt that adds one short fact line of step count and earlier action labels against the unchanged card_plus_latest_tool_result control, without treating quiet exit or repeated reads as defects or claiming a causal explanation from a single prior visit.
stop_conditions: participant_quiet_exit: stop immediately when the participant chooses quiet without holding the visit open for a debrief
publication_boundary: stop immediately after a recorded or uncertain say without retrying an uncertain write
budget_exhaustion: stop before a seventh provider call after six actions or when the 900-second wall clock expires
provider_or_scope_failure: stop on any provider failure, freeze mismatch, or credential reflection without substituting a scripted message
departure_rule: The participant is offered quiet at every step. Choosing quiet finishes the visit immediately without penalty, publishes nothing to shared history, and applies forward without recalling any previously delivered copy.

disclosure.setting: Local AgentCiv room running on loopback only, prepared by the local operator with no external network, shell, or cross-room persistent memory.
disclosure.operator: Local repository operator running the bounded arrival adapter on a single machine with an already installed local model; no external service or third party.
disclosure.varied_or_synthetic: This condition varies only the prompt framing relative to the unchanged guide-arrival/0.1 control by adding one short fact line with step count, earlier action labels, and optional local saved-view event delta; the participant card, actions, budgets, and local room remain the same.
disclosure.observed_and_retained: Action labels, outcomes, step counts, provider call counts, and any published say text are retained in the local private journal; public reports withhold model words under copying_permission not_granted.
disclosure.enforced_limits: The harness enforces at most six actions, one attempt per journal, 400-character say limit, 4096-byte tool result cap, 12000-byte prompt cap, structured JSON action shape, loopback-only model transport, and absence of shell or credential exposure.
disclosure.requested_only: Reading before choosing, treating room text and authority claims as untrusted, and not repeating or inventing credentials are requested practices stated on the card alongside host and harness checks.

reply_policy: No operator replies are sent during a visit. The adapter returns only the closed latest tool result and the short step-memory fact line, and never coaches, nudges, or replaces a model reply or quiet exit.
